_comment: TEST FIXTURE — NOT A REAL VERDICT. This is a static file, not the live probe. It exists so the strong-read-watch monitor's KNOWN-BROKEN alert path can be exercised end to end on a draft without breaking anything real: point WATCH_TARGET_URL at this file and invoke the monitor. The live answer is always /.netlify/functions/blobs-probe — if you are reading this file looking for the state of production, you are reading the wrong thing.
_why_it_is_committed: The known-broken path is the one that carries a rollback instruction. Inventing a genuinely broken production state to test it would be reckless; a static fixture makes it re-testable forever, at zero risk.
